news.analysis: Jones almost led the Colts to an upset win over the Cowboys at home, as the Colts were up 23-20 with under two minutes left in the game. His lone touchdown pass went to Ashton Dulin on a 55-yard completion in the third quarter. Jones has thrown just six touchdowns and nine interceptions through nine games in what has been a disappointing season for him. A low-end QB2 in fantasy moving forward, he will take on the Dolphins in Week 10.
news.contents: Daniel Jones completed 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding 11 yards on three rushes in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.title: Daniel Jones throws one TD in Week 9

news.contents: Indianapolis Colts quarterback Daniel Jones won't be moved at the upcoming trade deadline, per Tom Pelissero. The team informed Jones this weekend that they won't be trading him by Tuesday's deadline. They've fielded offers for him, but they've ultimately decided to keep the veteran quarterback. Jones isn't exactly having a great year under center, so it's not shocking to see a ton of buzz for him right now. The Colts could potentially attempt to move him again in the offseason. news.title: Daniel Jones Won't be Traded at the Deadline

Price worked behind fellow running back Zach Charbonnet in the ground game, as Charbonnet carried the ball 16 times for 77 yards (4.8 yards per carry). news.analysis: Kamara was second among the Saints' running backs in carries, but first in targets. If Audric Estime is going to see an expanded role while Travis Etienne is still on the shelf, it's going to make life hard for Kamara, who is hanging on to fantasy relevance by a thread.
news.contents: Alvin Kamara ran six times for 32 yards and caught three of four targets for 17 yards in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.title: Alvin Kamara runs for 32 yards in win

news.contents: New Orleans Saints running back Alvin Kamara rushed six times for just five yards while adding seven receptions for 57 yards in Week 7's loss to the Steelers. Kamara has been extremely inefficient this season, averaging a career-low 3.0 yards per carry and just 20.8 rushing yards per game. His receiving usage has been the only thing keeping him afloat from a fantasy perspective, as his seven receptions led the team in Week 7. news.analysis: Williams was bottled up by an underrated Miami defense, finishing with less than 50 receiving yards for the first time in his last six games. The wideout will look to return to his explosive form against the New England Patriots in Week 10.
news.contents: Jameson Williams hauled in one of his two targets for 31 yards while also rushing once for nine yards in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
news.title: Jameson Williams sees two touches in Week 9 win

His 31-yard catch in the third quarter set up Jahmyr Gibbs' rushing touchdown. Williams' only other target came on an incomplete deep throw to open the second quarter. news.contents: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce continues to defy Father Time in 2026 and was the team's leading receiver in their 35-12 blowout win at home against the New York Jets on Sunday in Week 9 to snap a two-game losing streak. Kelce was once again one of quarterback Patrick Mahomes' favorite weapons, catching four of his six targets for a team-high 72 receiving yards. news.analysis: Folk missed another field goal attempt Sunday, marking his fifth missed field goal this season. Folk will look to bounce back against Kansas City in Week 10.
news.contents: Nick Folk connected on 1-of-2 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts in a 34-17 loss to the Benglas.
news.title: Nick Folk misses another kick in Week 9

news.analysis: Miller had his moments, but could never string anything together during his injury-riddled career in New Orleans. He didn't seem to endear himself to coaching staff's either, as multiple different coaches passed over him for the starting job unless they had no other option. He will look to find a new home elsewhere.
news.contents: Kendre Miller has been released by the New Orleans Saints.
news.title: Kendre Miller released by the Saints

news.contents: The New Orleans Saints released running back Kendre Miller on Saturday, a source told Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football. It is a bit of a surprising move, as Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) remains on Injured Reserve after not having his 21-day practice window opened by the Saints this week. The 24-year-old Miller will finish the year with the Saints having carried the football a career-high 57 times for 159 yards (2.8 yards per attempt) and two rushing touchdowns, adding nine receptions ...
news.title: Saints Release Kendre Miller

news.title: Jerry Jeudy snags two passes in loss

news.analysis: Engram entered Sunday with two receiving yards over his previous two games combined. So, four catches for 33 yards represent an improvement. That said, Engram still hasn't established himself as a consistent part of Denver's passing attack. He remains difficult to start in fantasy leagues outside of deeper formats.

news.contents: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk (knee) recently met with the organization to discuss being reinstated. Aiyuk submitted the paperwork to be reinstated in late October, but there has yet to be a resolution. The biggest obstacle is the fact that Aiyuk owes the 49ers $13 million in bonus forfeitures.
